integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained once the published definition of \(C_B\) is fixed. A bundled standard-library checker replays the stationary polynomial identity, root isolation, maximizing witness, and numerical objective. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the real two-dimensional space \(\ell_4^2\); no arbitrary-\(p\) formula is claimed. The defining article and closest related literature were inspected, but unindexed prior work remains a residual originality risk.
title: Exact Birkhoff i-angle cosine constant of the real \(\ell_4^2\) plane
